title: The Lang-Trotter conjecture on average for genus-2 curves: the image of Phi for p congruent to 3 modulo 8 (Proposition 4.7)
author: Chihiro Ando
work: The Lang-Trotter conjecture on average for genus-2 curves with Klein-4 reduced automorphism group
difficulty_reason: With the paper's own prerequisites available - the superspeciality criterion of Ibukiyama, Katsura and Oort (source label arigataya), the equality T p = U p for p congruent to 3 modulo 8 (source label tpup), the injectivity of the map Phi (source label injective) and the definitions of Sigma p, Theta p, T prime p and the two equivalence relations - the counted proof is a genuinely source-local two-case computation rather than a routine citation. It must show first that every class in Theta p modulo approx is attained, by exhibiting for Lambda(lambda) in that set the genus-2 curve C lambda with the two associated elliptic curves supersingular and reading off Phi(lambda) approx Lambda(lambda); and then that every class in T prime p modulo approx is attained, by solving lambda = (t squared + 1) over 2t for a square root parameter, verifying the identity lambda squared minus 1 = (t squared minus 1) squared over 4 t squared and checking that minus (lambda minus the square root of lambda squared minus 1) squared is equivalent to minus t squared independently of the choice of square root. The residual difficulty is that of a careful research-paper step, using the Legendre-curve dictionary and the two named superspeciality inputs, and it is beyond a qualifying-examination exercise although shorter than the paper's main assembly of Theorem A.
